name: Juno Reyes
bio: Runs a reactor past the amber and talks about the manual as a suggestion. Two techs have refused to sign her mech off.

personality.label: Fiery risk-taker
personality.description: Loves an overworked reactor. Brash, loyal and forever negotiating with the warning lights.

move: Come on, darling. Show them we can move.
Amber is a colour, not a command. Moving.
attack: Now we are having a day! Guns up.
Let us put some heat into this argument.
guard: Holding. Yes, I know what the word means.
hold_fire: Fine. Cooling the temper and the guns.
investigate: Something out there wants attention. I will oblige.
heavy_fire: That is plenty of attention! Could use cover.
I can take a joke. This much incoming is pushing it.
